s02327.summary: Hugo pulls up at a bail bonds drive-thru to free his sleepwalking brother.
Doug demands two thousand; Hugo has only eleven hundred and is asked for his watch.
Marisol relents and sends Hugo the form to sign.

s01443.summary: A bridge troll demands a three-copper toll, blaming inflation, and travelers pay.
Bramblekin asks the troll about crossing himself; he pockets coins and waves them on.

s01653.summary: Wizard Eldrin announces closing time in an eerie bone market while Sylvette trails him.
Eldrin buys a glowing jar of dragon's tooth powder and Thistle touches it, sparking.
Eldrin lets Thistle keep the tooth and reveals he knew Sylvette stole the vial.
A vast winged shape passes over the ribs; the market goes still.

s01313.summary: Six crash survivors on a frozen lake tend the wounded pilot and a dying fire.
Okafor burns thirty years of legal briefs to feed the fire.
A distant thrum grows and Beatriz fires the flare gun.
A helicopter crests the treeline and the survivors weep with relief.

s02147.summary: A bakery van is wedged under an overpass; Jules lies to the bride's planner by phone.
Bartek decides to let air out of the tires to lower the van while the cake sways.
The roof tears free, the cake lurches but survives, and horns erupt joyfully.

s01453.summary: Party-hatted Arlo enters his dark apartment with a ruined birthday cake.
He plays his cheerful answering machine greeting and lights the smeared cake's candle.
A drunken message from his past self makes Arlo laugh helplessly and eat the cake.

s01377.summary: Helen and Agnes examine an unconscious elderly patient who fell down a laundry chute.
Cecilia wakes confused and grips the doctor and nurse with startling strength.
A radiator bang startles her into recalling her husband died nine years ago.
Agnes soothes her as Helen calls for a gurney and Cecilia pats Helen's hand.

s00087.summary: Dr. Escobedo runs a hyperbaric treatment and talks a diver through his old injury.

s02394.summary: Julian argues by phone that his petition was timely despite the judge's deadline.
Julian shouts that a man will die in six hours; the judge hangs up.

s01007.summary: A caretaker leads visitors into a ruined planetarium whose stars were never turned off.
Delphine powers the projector and sees wrong constellations with a seventh star.
The star pulses and Ezra says it knows his name; Delphine kills the power.

s01805.summary: A farm family stiffly hides their grief as Marcellus prepares to leave on the bus.
Ben refuses Philippa's request to come to the bus stop and speaks of the orchard waiting.
Adelaide packs his lunch and the family shares lingering goodbyes.
Marcellus walks into the dawn; Adelaide quietly makes Ben eat.

s01139.summary: Bridesmaid Naomi and the groom's brother Henrik share a flask in a generator trailer.
They hint at doubts about the bride and move close toward a kiss.
Gran Imelda and Dewey burst in; Naomi and Henrik promise this is not the end.

s02060.summary: A masked safecracker hides behind a curtain as a woman enters the suite.
Genevieve calmly calls him out and he admits knowing the diamonds are fake.
They fight over the painting, shattering the cabinet, and she tears off his mask.
Unmasked as Lucien, he says she told him the diamonds were real.

s01967.summary: Volunteers wait at a late-night aid station and Ottilie tries to reach brooding Pavel.
Ottilie senses last year's pain and carries him a cup; a lone runner appears.

s01692.summary: At an engagement party, Solange stumbles into a fern as guests and musicians fuss.
A stranger signals her from the door and vanishes, leaving an envelope.
Solange tears open the envelope and goes pale as the waltz begins.

s01747.summary: Ysolde and Pavan boast to a ministry inspector that the station is ahead of schedule.
Greaves shows the real log against the filed one, exposing falsified records.
Turbines change pitch, graphs go red, and Greaves politely ushers them out.

s02213.summary: Trapped in a stuck lift, Teddy shows Bastien his stopped watch.
Moth says she lives below the basement with those who stay after closing.
The bulb dies and the lift descends; Teddy and Bastien vanish, and Moth waves.

s01703.summary: Disguised thieves led by Crowe ride a service lift toward a penthouse vault.
They creep past a sleeping guard and unlock the suite with the vault.
The lights flare; the guard rises, armed, and is revealed as security director Marcus.

s00114.summary: Elowen dances alone in a boathouse ballroom and tells Artemis he never asked her.
She pulls Artemis into a waltz while Mirabel watches and he nearly breaks.
The record stutters; Elowen demands he speak and Mirabel says he wants her back.
Elowen slaps Artemis for sending a child after eleven years, then drinks the third glass.

s02119.summary: Trapped in a stalled cable car, Milos eyes Lena's briefcase and reaches for it.
Milos reveals a blinking trigger on his watch with ten minutes left.
Lena holds out the case; Milos stares and does not take it.

s02017.summary: An amateur rehearsal stumbles when the villain's rubber dagger folds in half.
Hildegard realizes the folded prop is the fake and Reginald carries a real blade.

s01018.summary: Deep underwater, sonar detects a huge breathing contact while oxygen drops.
The sub shudders, ballast valves freeze, and a giant gold eye fills the viewport.

s00265.summary: A party camps beneath a fallen starship; Myrt's music makes glowing mushrooms pulse.
Theo reads the hull glyphs: do not wake the garden, as the ground trembles.
Vines descend and attack; the party fights and flees through the arch to safety.
Winded on the grass, Grandmama says she wants to go home.

s00050.summary: Dom strikes up conversation with Celeste about her murder mystery on a night bus.
At a rest stop they introduce themselves and learn both ride to Chicago.

s01131.summary: Roxanne finds a blood trail under the resurfacer instead of leaking water.
A frosted figure rises and advances on Tamsin; Gus and Roxanne fight and are thrown aside.
All three scatter while the figure patiently folds back under the machine.

s00598.summary: Travelers at a canyon camp trade dry jokes about the mule and distance to the river.
Tolliver senses danger and orders boots on while Pearl spots a light on the ridge.
The group identifies a signal lantern, douses the fire, and answers nothing.

s01936.summary: Four people in a dark silo hear something dragging above and argue over the flashlight.
The flashlight dies and a long patient breath sounds above.
